name: Fillet
author: Victor Sanchez
description: Attaches every bar popup flush to the bar with fillet curves into it, so bar and popups read as one surface.

barWidget.description: Invisible widget; restyles all bar popups to attach to the bar.

schema.label: Fillet radius (px)
schema.description: Radius of the curves into the bar and of the exposed popup corners.

schema.label: Outline
schema.description: Stroke the exposed popup edges in the popup border color. Off gives a fill-only surface.

schema.label: Bar edge line
schema.description: Draw the same outline along the bar's inner edge so bar and popups share one frame.

schema.label: Hover switches popups
schema.description: While a popup is open, hovering another widget that has a popup switches to it.

schema.label: Attach the Omarchy menu
schema.description: Open the Omarchy menu hanging from the bar under its icon, styled like the popups and without the screen overlay.

schema.label: Menu icon
schema.description: Replace the Omarchy logo on the menu button with this text or glyph. Empty keeps the logo.

schema.label: Menu icon font
schema.description: Font family for the replacement icon. Empty uses the bar font.
